title: Search with a photo
lead: Show us the product, a part or its label, or describe it in your own words. We read it, look through the catalogue, and say why each result matches.
describePlaceholder: “A black leather bag with a chain strap”, a model number, what it's for…
addFile: Add a photo or a video
fileHint: A photo (PNG, JPEG, WebP, 5 MB) or a video of up to 30 seconds.
needSomething: Describe it or add a photo.
rateLimited: Too many searches for now. Try again in a few minutes.
failed: The search didn't go through. Try again.
limited: Photo reading isn't available right now: we searched your words.
notAProduct: We couldn't see a product in this file. Describe it in words.
nothing: Nothing in the catalogue matches yet.
needsDescription: Describe it in a few words and we'll search again.
notItLead: Ask us to find it: an agent searches for it and sends you a price that covers everything to your door.
dropHere: Drop a picture here, or choose a file. One at a time.
reading: Reading what you sent and looking through the catalogue. A photo can take a few seconds.
examples: Find this dress or something very similar.
